risks.risk: Engines may be seized or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video showing a technician manually rotating the crankshaft of each engine.

risks.risk: Specific make and model compatibility is unknown, affecting market demand.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the engine identification codes or serial number plates on the blocks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lowest-value generic engine type.

risks.risk: Internal sludge or poor maintenance history.
risks.proof: Photos of the valvetrain taken through the oil filler cap hole.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as units requiring a complete teardown and rebuild.

risks.risk: Missing essential bolt-on accessories (alternators, AC compressors, wiring harnesses).
risks.proof: Individual wide-angle photos of each engine showing all sides.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of engine model codes and serial numbers for identification.
Video evidence of the crankshafts being turned to confirm they are not seized.
Photos of the oil filler ports with caps removed to check for sludge.
A manifest or list detailing the specific vehicle models these engines were pulled from.
response.reason: The witness identified the items only as generic car engines; without specific brands and model codes, it is impossible to establish a baseline value for the Lagos market.
